title: 正交異性鋼橋面板製作
subcategoryTitle: 橋梁施工工法與大型架設
subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge construction methods and heavy erection
summary: 從輪載經面板、縱肋、橫梁到主梁的局部與整體傳力出發，以疲勞為主控計算面板厚度，再處理 U 形肋冷彎、肋—面板部分滲透焊、面板單元焊接變形、工地拼接收縮、非破壞檢測與試拼裝，最後以鋪面協同、疲勞熱點檢查與裂縫成長評估交接，並以金門大橋 1982 至 1986 年換裝鋼橋面、Lions Gate 橋與 Millau 高架橋為案例。
summaryEn: Starting from the local and global load path from wheel to deck plate, ribs, floorbeams and main girders, size the deck plate with fatigue governing, then handle cold-formed U-ribs, rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds, panel welding distortion, site-splice shrinkage, non-destructive testing and trial assembly, and finally hand over with surfacing interaction, fatigue hot-spot inspection and crack-growth assessment, using the Golden Gate Bridge's 1982–1986 redecking, Lions Gate and Millau as cases.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力」與「疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck" and "Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 正交異性鋼橋面由一片薄鋼面板、與其焊接的密排縱肋，以及間隔數公尺的橫梁組成，兩個方向勁度不同，故名正交異性。輪載先使面板在相鄰肋腹板之間局部受彎，再由縱肋把荷重以連續梁方式傳到橫梁，橫梁再傳到主梁或箱梁腹板；同時整片面板與縱肋又是主梁的上翼板，承受整體彎曲的縱向應力。這種一板多用的設計使橋面重量遠低於混凝土橋面，因此長跨懸索橋、斜張橋與活動橋普遍採用，但也意味著每一處焊接細部都承受局部與整體應力的疊加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An orthotropic steel deck consists of a thin steel deck plate, closely spaced longitudinal ribs welded to it and floorbeams a few metres apart, with different stiffness in the two directions, hence the name. A wheel load first bends the deck plate locally between adjacent rib webs; the ribs then carry the load as continuous beams to the floorbeams, which pass it to the main girders or box webs. At the same time the deck plate and ribs act as the top flange of the main girder, carrying longitudinal stress from global bending. This multiple use makes the deck far lighter than concrete, so long suspension, cable-stayed and movable bridges widely adopt it, but it also means every welded detail sees local and global stresses superimposed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：輪載 P = 75 kN、輪印長 0.4 m，面板在肋腹板間跨距 s = 0.3 m 以兩端固定板條計：w = 75×(0.3/0.4)/0.3 = 187.5 kN/m，M = w·s²/12 ≈ 1.41 kN·m；面板 16 mm 時 S = 0.4×0.016²/6 ≈ 1.71×10⁻⁵ m³，σ ≈ 82 MPa；12 mm 時 σ ≈ 146 MPa，增加約 78%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a wheel load P = 75 kN on a 0.4 m long patch and a deck plate spanning s = 0.3 m between rib webs as a fixed-ended strip, w = 75×(0.3/0.4)/0.3 = 187.5 kN/m and M = w·s²/12 ≈ 1.41 kN·m; with a 16 mm plate S = 0.4×0.016²/6 ≈ 1.71×10⁻⁵ m³ and σ ≈ 82 MPa; with 12 mm, σ ≈ 146 MPa, about 78% more.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力
knowledge.titleEn: Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck
knowledge.text: 正交異性鋼橋面由一片薄鋼面板、與其焊接的密排縱肋，以及間隔數公尺的橫梁組成，兩個方向勁度不同，故名正交異性。輪載先使面板在相鄰肋腹板之間局部受彎，再由縱肋把荷重以連續梁方式傳到橫梁，橫梁再傳到主梁或箱梁腹板；同時整片面板與縱肋又是主梁的上翼板，承受整體彎曲的縱向應力。
knowledge.textEn: An orthotropic steel deck consists of a thin steel deck plate, closely spaced longitudinal ribs welded to it and floorbeams a few metres apart, with different stiffness in the two directions, hence the name. A wheel load first bends the deck plate locally between adjacent rib webs; the ribs then carry the load as continuous beams to the floorbeams, which pass it to the main girders or box webs.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck" is correct?
options: 鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。
正交異性鋼橋面由一片薄鋼面板、與其焊接的密排縱肋，以及間隔數公尺的橫梁組成，兩個方向勁度不同，故名正交異性。
鋼橋面板只要強度足夠，疲勞可以等出現裂縫再處理。
optionsEn: A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough.

An orthotropic steel deck consists of a thin steel deck plate, closely spaced longitudinal ribs welded to it and floorbeams a few metres apart, with different stiffness in the two directions, hence the name.
If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear.
quiz.explanation: 正交異性鋼橋面由一片薄鋼面板、與其焊接的密排縱肋，以及間隔數公尺的橫梁組成，兩個方向勁度不同，故名正交異性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An orthotropic steel deck consists of a thin steel deck plate, closely spaced longitudinal ribs welded to it and floorbeams a few metres apart, with different stiffness in the two directions, hence the name. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：輪載 P = 75 kN、輪印長 0.4 m，面板在肋腹板間跨距 s = 0.3 m 以兩端固定板條計：w = 75×(0.3/0.4)/0.3 = 187.5 kN/m，M = w·s²/12 ≈ 1.41 kN·m；面板 16 mm 時 S = 0.4×0.016²/6 ≈ 1.71×10⁻⁵ m³，σ ≈ 82 MPa；12 mm 時 σ ≈ 146 MPa，增加約 78%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a wheel load P = 75 kN on a 0.4 m long patch and a deck plate spanning s = 0.3 m between rib webs as a fixed-ended strip, w = 75×(0.3/0.4)/0.3 = 187.5 kN/m and M = w·s²/12 ≈ 1.41 kN·m; with a 16 mm plate S = 0.4×0.016²/6 ≈ 1.71×10⁻⁵ m³ and σ ≈ 82 MPa; with 12 mm, σ ≈ 146 MPa, about 78% more. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計時以局部有限元素模型（殼元素，含輪印與鋪面）計算面板、肋—面板焊縫與肋—橫梁連接的應力，與手算板條模型比較量級；並在整體模型中取出同一位置的整體縱向應力，檢查兩者疊加後的設計值與疲勞應力幅。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage, compute stresses in the deck plate, rib-to-deck welds and rib-to-floorbeam connections with a local shell finite-element model including the wheel patch and surfacing, compare the order of magnitude with the hand strip model, and take the global longitudinal stress at the same location from the global model to check the superimposed design value and fatigue stress range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck", which statement holds?
options: 肋—面板焊縫焊得越深越好，最好完全燒穿。
工地對接焊只會影響局部，不會改變整跨長度。
輪載 P = 75 kN、輪印長 0.4 m，面板在肋腹板間跨距 s = 0.3 m 以兩端固定板條計：w = 75×(0.3/0.4)/0.3 = 187.5 kN/m，M = w·s²/12 ≈ 1.41 kN·m。
optionsEn: The deeper the rib-to-deck weld the better; full melt-through is best.
Site butt welds are local and do not change the length of a whole span.
For a wheel load P = 75 kN on a 0.4 m long patch and a deck plate spanning s = 0.3 m between rib webs as a fixed-ended strip, w = 75×(0.3/0.4)/0.3 = 187.5 kN/m and M = w·s²/12 ≈ 1.41 kN·m.

Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計時以局部有限元素模型（殼元素，含輪印與鋪面）計算面板、肋—面板焊縫與肋—橫梁連接的應力，與手算板條模型比較量級；並在整體模型中取出同一位置的整體縱向應力，檢查兩者疊加後的設計值與疲勞應力幅。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At design stage, compute stresses in the deck plate, rib-to-deck welds and rib-to-floorbeam connections with a local shell finite-element model including the wheel patch and surfacing, compare the order of magnitude with the hand strip model, and take the global longitudinal stress at the same location from the global model to check the superimposed design value and fatigue stress range. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計報告須同時提供整體與局部模型的關鍵細部應力表，並標示重車道與輪跡位置；製造廠的焊接程序與檢驗計畫必須依這些關鍵細部分級，而不是對所有焊縫一視同仁。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design report must give tables of key detail stresses from both global and local models and mark heavy lanes and wheel paths; the fabricator's welding procedures and inspection plan must be graded by these key details rather than treating every weld alike.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用整體模型設計主梁、把橋面板視為均勻翼板，會漏掉輪載下面板的局部彎曲；早期採用較薄面板的橋梁，常在重車道輪跡下方出現沿肋—面板焊縫的縱向疲勞裂縫，並使上方鋪面開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing the main girders with a global model alone, treating the deck as a uniform flange, misses local plate bending under wheels; early decks with thinner plates often developed longitudinal fatigue cracks along rib-to-deck welds beneath heavy-lane wheel paths, cracking the surfacing above. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計時以局部有限元素模型（殼元素，含輪印與鋪面）計算面板、肋—面板焊縫與肋—橫梁連接的應力，與手算板條模型比較量級；並在整體模型中取出同一位置的整體縱向應力，檢查兩者疊加後的設計值與疲勞應力幅。
knowledge.textEn: At design stage, compute stresses in the deck plate, rib-to-deck welds and rib-to-floorbeam connections with a local shell finite-element model including the wheel patch and surfacing, compare the order of magnitude with the hand strip model, and take the global longitudinal stress at the same location from the global model to check the superimposed design value and fatigue stress range.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計報告須同時提供整體與局部模型的關鍵細部應力表，並標示重車道與輪跡位置；製造廠的焊接程序與檢驗計畫必須依這些關鍵細部分級，而不是對所有焊縫一視同仁。
knowledge.textEn: The design report must give tables of key detail stresses from both global and local models and mark heavy lanes and wheel paths; the fabricator's welding procedures and inspection plan must be graded by these key details rather than treating every weld alike.

quiz.question: 要驗證「正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck"?
options: 設計時以局部有限元素模型（殼元素，含輪印與鋪面）計算面板、肋—面板焊縫與肋—橫梁連接的應力，與手算板條模型比較量級。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要每個節段尺寸各自合格，到現場一定能順利對接。
optionsEn: At design stage, compute stresses in the deck plate, rib-to-deck welds and rib-to-floorbeam connections with a local shell finite-element model including the wheel patch and surfacing, compare the order of magnitude with the hand strip model, and take the global longitudinal stress at the same location from the global model to check the superimposed design value and fatigue stress range.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If every segment is individually within tolerance, they will always fit on site.
quiz.explanation: 設計時以局部有限元素模型（殼元素，含輪印與鋪面）計算面板、肋—面板焊縫與肋—橫梁連接的應力，與手算板條模型比較量級；並在整體模型中取出同一位置的整體縱向應力，檢查兩者疊加後的設計值與疲勞應力幅。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At design stage, compute stresses in the deck plate, rib-to-deck welds and rib-to-floorbeam connections with a local shell finite-element model including the wheel patch and surfacing, compare the order of magnitude with the hand strip model, and take the global longitudinal stress at the same location from the global model to check the superimposed design value and fatigue stress range. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用整體模型設計主梁、把橋面板視為均勻翼板，會漏掉輪載下面板的局部彎曲；早期採用較薄面板的橋梁，常在重車道輪跡下方出現沿肋—面板焊縫的縱向疲勞裂縫，並使上方鋪面開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing the main girders with a global model alone, treating the deck as a uniform flange, misses local plate bending under wheels; early decks with thinner plates often developed longitudinal fatigue cracks along rib-to-deck welds beneath heavy-lane wheel paths, cracking the surfacing above. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種一板多用的設計使橋面重量遠低於混凝土橋面，因此長跨懸索橋、斜張橋與活動橋普遍採用，但也意味著每一處焊接細部都承受局部與整體應力的疊加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This multiple use makes the deck far lighter than concrete, so long suspension, cable-stayed and movable bridges widely adopt it, but it also means every welded detail sees local and global stresses superimposed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用整體模型設計主梁、把橋面板視為均勻翼板，會漏掉輪載下面板的局部彎曲；早期採用較薄面板的橋梁，常在重車道輪跡下方出現沿肋—面板焊縫的縱向疲勞裂縫，並使上方鋪面開裂。
knowledge.textEn: Designing the main girders with a global model alone, treating the deck as a uniform flange, misses local plate bending under wheels; early decks with thinner plates often developed longitudinal fatigue cracks along rib-to-deck welds beneath heavy-lane wheel paths, cracking the surfacing above.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只用整體模型設計主梁、把橋面板視為均勻翼板，會漏掉輪載下面板的局部彎曲。
鋼橋面板只要強度足夠，疲勞可以等出現裂縫再處理。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Designing the main girders with a global model alone, treating the deck as a uniform flange, misses local plate bending under wheels.
If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear.
quiz.explanation: 只用整體模型設計主梁、把橋面板視為均勻翼板，會漏掉輪載下面板的局部彎曲；早期採用較薄面板的橋梁，常在重車道輪跡下方出現沿肋—面板焊縫的縱向疲勞裂縫，並使上方鋪面開裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing the main girders with a global model alone, treating the deck as a uniform flange, misses local plate bending under wheels; early decks with thinner plates often developed longitudinal fatigue cracks along rib-to-deck welds beneath heavy-lane wheel paths, cracking the surfacing above. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「肋—面板焊縫應力幅」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rib-to-deck weld stress range” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 正交異性橋面的設計通常不是由強度控制，而是由疲勞控制：每一個重車輪通過都在面板與焊縫產生一次應力循環，百年內次數可達數億。焊接細部的疲勞壽命依 S–N 曲線與應力幅的三次方成反比，而面板局部彎曲應力約與厚度平方成反比，所以面板稍微加厚，壽命就大幅增加。FHWA 2012 年手冊把面板最小厚度提高到 14 至 16 mm 列為近年改進之一，正是早期薄面板疲勞經驗的反映。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「肋—面板焊縫應力幅」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Orthotropic deck design is usually governed not by strength but by fatigue: every heavy wheel causes one stress cycle in the plate and welds, adding up to hundreds of millions over a century. Welded-detail fatigue life is inversely proportional to the cube of stress range on the S–N curve, while local plate bending stress varies roughly with the inverse square of thickness, so a slightly thicker plate greatly extends life. FHWA's 2012 manual lists raising the minimum deck-plate thickness to 14 to 16 mm among recent improvements, reflecting the fatigue experience of early thin plates. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rib-to-deck weld stress range” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：S–N：N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³，取細部類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: S–N: N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³ with a detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼橋面板只要強度足夠，疲勞可以等出現裂縫再處理。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「肋—面板焊縫應力幅」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rib-to-deck weld stress range”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇
knowledge.text: 正交異性橋面的設計通常不是由強度控制，而是由疲勞控制：每一個重車輪通過都在面板與焊縫產生一次應力循環，百年內次數可達數億。焊接細部的疲勞壽命依 S–N 曲線與應力幅的三次方成反比，而面板局部彎曲應力約與厚度平方成反比，所以面板稍微加厚，壽命就大幅增加。
knowledge.textEn: Orthotropic deck design is usually governed not by strength but by fatigue: every heavy wheel causes one stress cycle in the plate and welds, adding up to hundreds of millions over a century. Welded-detail fatigue life is inversely proportional to the cube of stress range on the S–N curve, while local plate bending stress varies roughly with the inverse square of thickness, so a slightly thicker plate greatly extends life.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼橋面板只要強度足夠，疲勞可以等出現裂縫再處理。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness" is correct?
options: 鋼橋面板只要強度足夠，疲勞可以等出現裂縫再處理。
縱肋只是加勁板，用一般鋼板隨意冷彎即可。
正交異性橋面的設計通常不是由強度控制，而是由疲勞控制：每一個重車輪通過都在面板與焊縫產生一次應力循環，百年內次數可達數億。
optionsEn: If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear.
Ribs are mere stiffeners and can be cold-bent from any ordinary plate.
Orthotropic deck design is usually governed not by strength but by fatigue: every heavy wheel causes one stress cycle in the plate and welds, adding up to hundreds of millions over a century.
quiz.explanation: 正交異性橋面的設計通常不是由強度控制，而是由疲勞控制：每一個重車輪通過都在面板與焊縫產生一次應力循環，百年內次數可達數億。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Orthotropic deck design is usually governed not by strength but by fatigue: every heavy wheel causes one stress cycle in the plate and welds, adding up to hundreds of millions over a century. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「肋—面板焊縫應力幅」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rib-to-deck weld stress range” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：S–N：N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³，取細部類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa。16 mm 面板應力幅 45 MPa：N ≈ 2×10⁶×(71/45)³ ≈ 7.9×10⁶；改用 12 mm，應力幅乘 (16/12)² ≈ 1.78 成為 80 MPa，N ≈ 1.4×10⁶，壽命只剩約 1/5.6。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: S–N: N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³ with a detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa. A 16 mm plate with a 45 MPa stress range gives N ≈ 2×10⁶×(71/45)³ ≈ 7.9×10⁶; a 12 mm plate multiplies the stress range by (16/12)² ≈ 1.78 to 80 MPa, giving N ≈ 1.4×10⁶, about 1/5.6 of the life. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依規範疲勞荷載模型（重車軸重、橫向分布與車流量）計算關鍵細部的應力幅頻譜，以 Miner 累積損傷檢核設計年限；新型細部或沒有規範類別的細部，須以足尺疲勞試驗驗證，試體的焊接程序必須與量產一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute stress-range spectra at key details from the code fatigue load model (axle loads, transverse distribution and traffic volume) and check the design life by Miner's cumulative damage; new details without a code category need full-scale fatigue tests whose specimens are welded with the same procedure as production.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: S–N：N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³，取細部類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa。16 mm 面板應力幅 45 MPa：N ≈ 2×10⁶×(71/45)³ ≈ 7.9×10⁶；改用 12 mm，應力幅乘 (16/12)² ≈ 1.78 成為 80 MPa，N ≈ 1.4×10⁶，壽命只剩約 1/5.6。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: S–N: N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³ with a detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa. A 16 mm plate with a 45 MPa stress range gives N ≈ 2×10⁶×(71/45)³ ≈ 7.9×10⁶; a 12 mm plate multiplies the stress range by (16/12)² ≈ 1.78 to 80 MPa, giving N ≈ 1.4×10⁶, about 1/5.6 of the life. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness", which statement holds?
options: S–N：N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³，取細部類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa。
焊接變形可以等組裝時再用千斤頂硬拉回來。
焊縫外觀平滑、尺寸合格，就代表內部熔深足夠。
optionsEn: S–N: N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³ with a detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa.
Welding distortion can simply be pulled out with jacks during assembly.
A smooth weld of the right size must have adequate penetration inside.
quiz.explanation: S–N：N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³，取細部類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: S–N: N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³ with a detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「肋—面板焊縫應力幅」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rib-to-deck weld stress range” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依規範疲勞荷載模型（重車軸重、橫向分布與車流量）計算關鍵細部的應力幅頻譜，以 Miner 累積損傷檢核設計年限；新型細部或沒有規範類別的細部，須以足尺疲勞試驗驗證，試體的焊接程序必須與量產一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute stress-range spectra at key details from the code fatigue load model (axle loads, transverse distribution and traffic volume) and check the design life by Miner's cumulative damage; new details without a code category need full-scale fatigue tests whose specimens are welded with the same procedure as production. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主規範應明訂面板最小厚度、縱肋最小厚度與關鍵細部的疲勞類別，並要求新細部須有試驗依據；設計審查時把疲勞計算列為必審項目，而不是附錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Owner specifications should set minimum deck-plate and rib thicknesses and fatigue categories for key details, require test evidence for new details, and treat fatigue calculations as a mandatory review item rather than an appendix.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以強度為主決定面板厚度、再事後補做疲勞檢核，常發現重車道細部壽命不足，只能局部加厚或更換細部，造成設計與製造反覆；若完全忽略疲勞，裂縫可能在通車十多年內就出現在輪跡下方。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sizing the plate for strength and checking fatigue afterwards often reveals insufficient life at heavy-lane details, forcing local thickening or detail changes and design–fabrication rework; ignoring fatigue entirely can let cracks appear beneath wheel paths within a decade or two of opening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依規範疲勞荷載模型（重車軸重、橫向分布與車流量）計算關鍵細部的應力幅頻譜，以 Miner 累積損傷檢核設計年限；新型細部或沒有規範類別的細部，須以足尺疲勞試驗驗證，試體的焊接程序必須與量產一致。
knowledge.textEn: Compute stress-range spectra at key details from the code fatigue load model (axle loads, transverse distribution and traffic volume) and check the design life by Miner's cumulative damage; new details without a code category need full-scale fatigue tests whose specimens are welded with the same procedure as production.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 業主規範應明訂面板最小厚度、縱肋最小厚度與關鍵細部的疲勞類別，並要求新細部須有試驗依據；設計審查時把疲勞計算列為必審項目，而不是附錄。
knowledge.textEn: Owner specifications should set minimum deck-plate and rib thicknesses and fatigue categories for key details, require test evidence for new details, and treat fatigue calculations as a mandatory review item rather than an appendix.

quiz.question: 要驗證「疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
依規範疲勞荷載模型（重車軸重、橫向分布與車流量）計算關鍵細部的應力幅頻譜，以 Miner 累積損傷檢核設計年限。
鋪面只是行車面，壞了換新就好，與鋼橋面疲勞無關。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Compute stress-range spectra at key details from the code fatigue load model (axle loads, transverse distribution and traffic volume) and check the design life by Miner's cumulative damage.
Surfacing is just a wearing course, unrelated to deck fatigue, and can simply be replaced when worn.
quiz.explanation: 依規範疲勞荷載模型（重車軸重、橫向分布與車流量）計算關鍵細部的應力幅頻譜，以 Miner 累積損傷檢核設計年限；新型細部或沒有規範類別的細部，須以足尺疲勞試驗驗證，試體的焊接程序必須與量產一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute stress-range spectra at key details from the code fatigue load model (axle loads, transverse distribution and traffic volume) and check the design life by Miner's cumulative damage; new details without a code category need full-scale fatigue tests whose specimens are welded with the same procedure as production. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「肋—面板焊縫應力幅」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rib-to-deck weld stress range” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以強度為主決定面板厚度、再事後補做疲勞檢核，常發現重車道細部壽命不足，只能局部加厚或更換細部，造成設計與製造反覆；若完全忽略疲勞，裂縫可能在通車十多年內就出現在輪跡下方。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sizing the plate for strength and checking fatigue afterwards often reveals insufficient life at heavy-lane details, forcing local thickening or detail changes and design–fabrication rework; ignoring fatigue entirely can let cracks appear beneath wheel paths within a decade or two of opening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：FHWA 2012 年手冊把面板最小厚度提高到 14 至 16 mm 列為近年改進之一，正是早期薄面板疲勞經驗的反映。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: FHWA's 2012 manual lists raising the minimum deck-plate thickness to 14 to 16 mm among recent improvements, reflecting the fatigue experience of early thin plates.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼橋面板只要強度足夠，疲勞可以等出現裂縫再處理。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以強度為主決定面板厚度、再事後補做疲勞檢核，常發現重車道細部壽命不足，只能局部加厚或更換細部，造成設計與製造反覆；若完全忽略疲勞，裂縫可能在通車十多年內就出現在輪跡下方。
knowledge.textEn: Sizing the plate for strength and checking fatigue afterwards often reveals insufficient life at heavy-lane details, forcing local thickening or detail changes and design–fabrication rework; ignoring fatigue entirely can let cracks appear beneath wheel paths within a decade or two of opening.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
縱肋只是加勁板，用一般鋼板隨意冷彎即可。
以強度為主決定面板厚度、再事後補做疲勞檢核，常發現重車道細部壽命不足，只能局部加厚或更換細部，造成設計與製造反覆。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Ribs are mere stiffeners and can be cold-bent from any ordinary plate.
Sizing the plate for strength and checking fatigue afterwards often reveals insufficient life at heavy-lane details, forcing local thickening or detail changes and design–fabrication rework.
quiz.explanation: 以強度為主決定面板厚度、再事後補做疲勞檢核，常發現重車道細部壽命不足，只能局部加厚或更換細部，造成設計與製造反覆；若完全忽略疲勞，裂縫可能在通車十多年內就出現在輪跡下方。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sizing the plate for strength and checking fatigue afterwards often reveals insufficient life at heavy-lane details, forcing local thickening or detail changes and design–fabrication rework; ignoring fatigue entirely can let cracks appear beneath wheel paths within a decade or two of opening. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
